name: Bookmarks
description: A place to put links so you can find them again. Paste a URL anywhere in the frame and it saves itself — no form, no dialog — reading the site's name off the address and colouring it so the same site always looks the same. The search box is the frame's real interface: it filters by title, address and tag as you type, because a link you cannot find again is the same as one you never saved. Tag anything, filter by tag, rename what the URL got wrong. Space editors save and edit; everyone else, including anyone the frame is shared with publicly, can read and follow the same links. Nothing is fetched from the sites you save: this frame asks for no network access at all, so a private bookmark stays a private bookmark. Links live in an encrypted LocalTable scoped to the placement.
